name: scruffy little dog
description: A thin flea-ridden mutt, growling as you get close.

name: village idiot
description: Drooling and comical, but then, what do you expect?

name: grey mold
description: A small strange grey growth.

name: jackal
description: It is a yapping snarling dog, dangerous when in a pack.

name: rock lizard
description: It is a small lizard with a hardened hide.

name: soldier ant
description: A large ant with powerful mandibles.

name: floating eye
description: A disembodied eye, floating a few feet above the ground.

name: small kobold
description: It is a squat and ugly humanoid figure with a canine face.

name: white worm mass
description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

name: Fang, Farmer Maggot's Dog
description: A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot. It thinks you are stealing mushrooms.

name: Grip, Farmer Maggot's Dog
description: A rather vicious dog belonging to Farmer Maggot. It thinks you are stealing mushrooms.

name: kobold
description: It is a small, dog-headed humanoid.

name: cave spider
description: It is a black spider that moves in fits and starts.

name: green naga
description: A large green serpent with a female's torso. Her green skin glistens with acid.

name: cave orc
description: He is often found in huge numbers in deep caves.

name: snaga
description: He is one of the many weaker 'slave' orcs, often mistakenly known as a goblin.

name: Bullroarer the Hobbit
description: He is a sturdy hobbit who is renowned for his unusual strength and vigour. He can prove a troublesome opponent.

name: wolf
description: It howls and snaps at you.

name: ghoul
description: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

name: fire giant
description: A glowing fourteen foot tall giant. Flames drip from its red skin.

name: kobold archer
description: It is an ugly dog-headed humanoid wielding a bow.

name: kobold shaman
description: It is a kobold dressed in skins and gesturing wildly.

name: hill orc
description: He is a hideous deformed cross-breed with man and orc, combining man's strength and cunning with orcish evil. The traitorous wizard Saruman is generally believed to be responsible for this abomination.

name: baby blue dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale blue.

name: Orfax, Son of Boldor
description: He's just like his daddy! He knows mighty spells, but fortunately he is a yeek.

name: Wormtongue, Agent of Saruman
description: He's been spying for Saruman. He is a snivelling wretch with no morals and disgusting habits.

name: filthy street urchin
description: He looks squalid and thoroughly revolting.

name: scrawny cat
description: A skinny little furball with sharp claws and a menacing look.

name: Farmer Maggot
description: He's lost his dogs. He's had his mushrooms stolen. He's not a happy hobbit!

name: blubbering idiot
description: He tends to blubber a lot.

name: boil-covered wretch
description: Ugly doesn't begin to describe him.

name: pitiful-looking beggar
description: You just can't help feeling sorry for him.

name: mangy-looking leper
description: You feel it isn't safe to touch him.

name: squint-eyed rogue
description: A hardy, street-wise crook that knows an easy catch when it sees one.

name: singing, happy drunk
description: He makes you glad to be sober.

name: aimless-looking merchant
description: The typical ponce around town, with purse jingling, and looking for more amulets of adornment to buy.

name: mean-looking mercenary
description: No job is too low for him.

name: battle-scarred veteran
description: He doesn't take to strangers kindly.

name: red-hatted elf
description: It's Yuletide and this elf has had a few too many.

name: Father Christmas
description: It's Saint Nick, out delivering presents to the town urchins.

name: grey mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

name: giant yellow centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: giant white centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: white icky thing
description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky creature.

name: clear icky thing
description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, blobby creature.

name: giant white mouse
description: It is about three feet long with large teeth.

name: large white snake
description: It is about eight feet long.

name: fruit bat
description: A fast-moving pest.

name: shrieker mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It doesn't sound so nice, though...

name: blubbering icky thing
description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, hungry creature.

name: metallic green centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: soldier
description: An inexperienced but tough warrior.

name: cutpurse
description: A rather shifty individual.

name: acolyte
description: He is tripping over his priestly robes.

name: apprentice
description: He is leaving behind a trail of dropped spell components.

name: yellow mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

name: white jelly
description: It's a large pile of white flesh.

name: giant green frog
description: It is as big as a wolf.

name: giant black ant
description: It is about three feet long.

name: salamander
description: A small black and orange lizard.

name: white harpy
description: A flying, screeching bird with a woman's face.

name: blue yeek
description: A small humanoid figure.

name: green worm mass
description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

name: wild cat
description: A larger than normal feline, hissing loudly. Its velvet paws conceal a fistful of needles.

name: crow
description: It is a hooded crow, gray except for the black wings and head.

name: Sméagol
description: Usually known as Gollum. He's been sneaking, and he wants his 'precious.'

name: green ooze
description: It's green and it's oozing.

name: poltergeist
description: It is a ghastly, ghostly form.

name: metallic blue centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: giant white louse
description: It is six inches long.

name: black naga
description: A large black serpent's body with a female torso.

name: spotted mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

name: silver jelly
description: It is a large pile of silver flesh that sucks all light from its surroundings.

name: yellow jelly
description: It's a large pile of yellow flesh.

name: scruffy looking hobbit
description: A short little guy, in bedraggled clothes. He appears to be looking for a good tavern.

name: giant white ant
description: It is about two feet long and has sharp pincers.

name: yellow mold
description: It is a strange yellow growth on the dungeon floor.

name: metallic red centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: yellow worm mass
description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

name: clear worm mass
description: It is a disgusting mass of poisonous worms.

name: radiation eye
description: A disembodied eye, crackling with energy.

name: cave lizard
description: It is an armoured lizard with a powerful bite.

name: scout
description: An agile hunter, ready and relaxed.

name: gallant
description: An adventurer both devoutly religious and skillful in combat.

name: tamer
description: A lover of nature.

name: blue jelly
description: It's a large pile of pulsing blue flesh.

name: creeping copper coins
description: It appears to be a pile of copper coins.

name: giant white rat
description: It is a very vicious rodent.

name: blue worm mass
description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

name: large grey snake
description: It is about ten feet long.

name: silver mouse
description: It is about three feet long with large teeth. As the light of your lamp falls on it, it seems to grow stronger.

name: blue ooze
description: It's blue and it's oozing.

name: green glutton ghost
description: It is a very ugly green ghost with a voracious appetite.

name: green jelly
description: It is a large pile of pulsing green flesh.

name: large kobold
description: It is a man-sized figure with the all too recognizable face of a kobold.

name: skeleton kobold
description: It is a small animated kobold skeleton.

name: grey icky thing
description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, nasty creature.

name: disenchanter eye
description: A disembodied eye, crackling with magic.

name: red worm mass
description: It is a large slimy mass of worms.

name: copperhead snake
description: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.

name: giant white dragon fly
description: It is a large fly that drips frost.

name: giant green dragon fly
description: A vast, foul-smelling dragonfly.

name: rot jelly
description: It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food. The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...

name: purple mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

name: brown mold
description: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.

name: giant brown bat
description: It screeches as it attacks.

name: creeping silver coins
description: It appears to be a pile of silver coins.

name: rattlesnake
description: It is recognized by the hard-scaled end of its body that is often rattled to frighten its prey.

name: giant black dragon fly
description: The size of a large bird, this fly drips caustic acid.

name: giant gold dragon fly
description: Large beating wings support this dazzling insect. A loud buzzing noise pervades the air.

name: crow of Durthang
description: A crook-beaked bird with bedraggled black feathers. It mocks you, and you realise that its scorn can kill.

name: wood spider
description: It scuttles towards you.

name: bloodshot eye
description: A disembodied eye, bloodshot and nasty.

name: red naga
description: A large red snake with a woman's torso.

name: red jelly
description: It is a large pulsating mound of red flesh.

name: giant red frog
description: It looks poisonous.

name: green icky thing
description: It is a smallish, slimy, icky, acidic creature.

name: zombified kobold
description: It is an animated kobold corpse. Flesh falls off in large chunks as it shambles forward.

name: lost soul
description: It is almost insubstantial.

name: eastern dwarf
description: A dwarf of one of the eastern kindreds who has fallen under the sway of Morgoth.

name: night lizard
description: It is a black lizard with overlapping scales and a powerful jaw.

name: Mughash the Kobold Lord
description: Strong and powerful, for a kobold.

name: Lagduf, the Snaga
description: A captain of a regiment of weaker orcs, Lagduf keeps his troop in order with displays of excessive violence.

name: terrified yeek
description: It is a strange small humanoid in a constant state of extreme terror.

name: giant salamander
description: A large black and yellow lizard. You'd better run away!

name: green mold
description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor.

name: skeleton orc
description: It is an animated orc skeleton.

name: lemure
description: It is a minor but aggressive demon.

name: orc tracker
description: A small orc with wide and snuffling nostrils.

name: ruffian
description: An uncultured brute with a club, a sling and a whip.

name: giant black louse
description: It makes you itch just to look at it.

name: yeti
description: A large white figure covered in shaggy fur.

name: bloodshot icky thing
description: It is a strange, slimy, icky creature.

name: giant grey rat
description: It is a rodent of unusual size.

name: black harpy
description: A woman's face on the body of a vicious black bird.

name: orc shaman
description: An orc dressed in skins who gestures wildly.

name: baby white dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale white.

name: baby green dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a sickly green.

name: baby black dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a dull black.

name: baby red dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale red.

name: giant red ant
description: It is large and has venomous mandibles.

name: Brodda, the Easterling
description: A nasty piece of work, Brodda picks on defenseless women and children.

name: king cobra
description: It is a large snake with a hooded face.

name: baby gold dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales a pale gold.

name: cave bear
description: A large bear appears to have made its home in this cave. It is hungry, and you are trespassing in its territory.

name: giant spider
description: It is a vast black spider whose bulbous body is bloated with poison.

name: blacklock mage
description: A corrupted dwarf from the east, dressed in black mail, hurling spells at you.

name: stonefoot warrior
description: A dwarf of the east in a coat of iron rings and wielding an axe.

name: clear mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty.

name: Grishnákh, the Hill Orc
description: He is a cunning and devious orc with a chaotic nature.

name: giant white tick
description: It is moving slowly towards you.

name: hairy mold
description: It is a strange hairy growth on the dungeon floor.

name: disenchanter mold
description: It is a strange glowing growth on the dungeon floor.

name: pseudo-dragon
description: A small relative of the dragon that inhabits dark caves.

name: tengu
description: It is a fast-moving demon that blinks quickly in and out of existence; no other demon matches its teleporting mastery.

name: creeping gold coins
description: It appears to be a pile of gold coins, until it starts crawling towards you on tiny legs.

name: giant fruit fly
description: A fast-breeding, annoying pest.

name: panther
description: A large black cat, stalking you with intent. It thinks you're its next meal.

name: witch
description: She is dressed in black and smells of decay.

name: baby multi-hued dragon
description: This hatchling dragon is still soft, its eyes unaccustomed to light and its scales shimmering with hints of many different colours.

name: hippogriff
description: A strange hybrid of eagle and horse. It looks weird.

name: zombified orc
description: It is a shambling orcish corpse leaving behind a trail of flesh.

name: drúadan mage
description: A mage of short stature with stumpy legs and a wispy beard.

name: old forest tree
description: An ancient tree that seems to be watching you.

name: black mamba
description: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body and highly venomous fangs.

name: white wolf
description: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy and its fur coated in frost.

name: grape jelly
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It is a pulsing mound of glowing flesh.

name: nether worm mass
description: It is a disgusting mass of dark worms, eating each other, the floor, the air, you....

name: Golfimbul, the Hill Orc Chief
description: A leader of a band of raiding orcs, he picks on hobbits.

name: master yeek
description: A small humanoid that radiates some power.

name: priest
description: A robed man, dedicated to his god.

name: ironfist priest
description: A dwarf of the east, dressed all in black, chanting words of dark sorcery.

name: air spirit
description: A whirlwind of sentient air.

name: skeleton human
description: It is an animated human skeleton.

name: zombified human
description: It is a shambling human corpse dropping chunks of flesh behind it.

name: tiger
description: One of the largest of its species, a sleek orange and black shape creeps towards you, ready to pounce.

name: moaning spirit
description: A ghostly apparition that shrieks horribly.

name: warrior
description: A warrior of considerable skill.

name: stegocentipede
description: It is a vast armoured centipede with massive mandibles and a spiked tail.

name: spotted jelly
description: A strange jelly thing, covered in discoloured blotches.

name: killer brown beetle
description: It is a vicious insect with a tough carapace.

name: ochre jelly
description: A fast moving highly acidic jelly thing, that is eating away the floor it rests on.

name: Boldor, King of the Yeeks
description: A great yeek, powerful in magic and sorcery, but a yeek all the same.

name: ogre
description: A hideous, smallish giant that is often found near or with orcs.

name: creeping mithril coins
description: It appears to be a pile of sentient mithril coins that doesn't like being picked up.

name: illusionist
description: A deceptive spell caster.

name: druid
description: A priest devoted to Nature.

name: orc archer
description: He has a bow of horn and a quiver full of black-feathered arrows.

name: giant flea
description: It makes you itch just to look at it.

name: Ufthak of Cirith Ungol
description: A strong orc guarding the pass of Cirith Ungol. He is mortally afraid of spiders.

name: blue icky thing
description: It is a strange, slimy, icky creature, with rudimentary intelligence, but evil cunning. It hungers for food, and you look tasty.

name: flesh golem
description: A shambling humanoid monster with long scars.

name: warg
description: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning.

name: lurker
description: A strange creature that merges with the dungeon floor, trapping its victims by enveloping them within its perfectly disguised form.

name: wererat
description: A large rat with glowing red eyes. The wererat is a disgusting creature, relishing in filth and disease.

name: black ogre
description: A massive orc-like figure with black skin and powerful arms.

name: magic mushroom patch
description: Yum! It looks quite tasty. It seems to glow with an unusual light.

name: guardian naga
description: A giant snake-like figure with a woman's torso.

name: light hound
description: A brilliant canine form whose light hurts your eyes, even at this distance.

name: dark hound
description: A hole in the air in the shape of a huge hound. No light falls upon its form.

name: giant tarantula
description: A giant, fast-moving spider with hairy black and red legs.

name: giant clear centipede
description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

name: griffon
description: It is half lion, half eagle. It flies menacingly towards you.

name: homunculus
description: It is a small demonic spirit full of malevolence.

name: clear hound
description: A completely translucent hound.

name: clay golem
description: It is a massive animated statue made out of hardened clay.

name: giant tan bat
description: A giant bat, the beating of whose wings produces a strangely unnerving noise.

name: umber hulk
description: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.

name: gelatinous cube
description: It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols. Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.

name: rogue
description: He is eyeing your backpack.

name: Ulfast, Son of Ulfang
description: A short and swarthy Easterling.

name: quasit
description: A demon of small stature with an annoying bite.

name: uruk
description: A cunning orc of power, as tall as a man, and stronger. It fears little.

name: grizzly bear
description: A huge, beastly bear, more savage than most of its kind.

name: craban
description: A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down, and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.

name: imp
description: A poisonous little mischief-maker.

name: forest troll
description: He is green skinned, ugly and stupid.

name: Nár, the Dwarf
description: The friend and companion of the dwarven king Thrór, he went mad with grief after Thrór's death at the hands of Azog the Orc. With torn beard and ragged clothes, he seems to have fixed on you as a convenient target to vent his anger.

name: 2-headed hydra
description: A strange reptilian hybrid with two heads, guarding its hoard.

name: water spirit
description: A whirlpool of sentient liquid.

name: giant red scorpion
description: It is fast and poisonous.

name: earth spirit
description: A whirling form of sentient rock.

name: hummerhorn
description: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger drips venom.

name: orc captain
description: An armoured orc with an air of authority.

name: blackguard
description: A hulking figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you menacingly.

name: fire spirit
description: A whirlwind of sentient flame.

name: fire hound
description: Flames lick at its feet and its tongue is a blade of fire. You can feel a furnace heat radiating from the creature.

name: cold hound
description: A hound as tall as a man, this creature appears to be composed of angular planes of ice. Cold radiates from it and freezes your breath in the air.

name: energy hound
description: Saint Elmo's Fire forms a ghostly halo around this hound, and sparks sting your fingers as energy builds up in the air around you.

name: potion mimic
description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded potion bottle to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

name: blink dog
description: A strange magical member of the canine race, its form seems to shimmer and fade in front of your very eyes.

name: shambling mound
description: A pile of rotting vegetation that slides towards you with a disgusting stench, waking all it nears.

name: evil eye
description: A huge disembodied eye. As you stare into the black nothingness of its pupil, you feel your will and vitality draining away, and are unable to do anything except approach it in horrified fascination.

name: Shagrat, the Orc Captain
description: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Cirith Ungol.

name: Gorbag, the Orc Captain
description: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Minas Morgul.

name: stone golem
description: It is a massive animated statue.

name: red mold
description: It is a strange red growth on the dungeon floor; it seems to burn with flame.

name: Old Man Willow
description: The ancient grey willow tree, ruler of the Old Forest. He despises trespassers in his territory. "...a huge willow-tree, old and hoary. Enormous it looked, its sprawling branches going up like racing arms with many long-fingered hands, its knotted and twisted trunk gaping in wide fissures that creaked faintly as the boughs moved."

name: blood falcon
description: A blinding whirlwind of fear and feathers. Its razor sharp beak and talons fill its foes with terror as it seeks to rend flesh from bone with unbridled ferocity.

name: Mirkwood spider
description: A strong and powerful spider from Mirkwood forest. Cunning and evil, it seeks to taste your juicy insides.

name: Bolg, Son of Azog
description: A large and powerful orc, he looks just like his father. He is tall and fast, but fortunately blessed with orcish brains.

name: 3-headed hydra
description: A 2-headed hydra with an extra head, its mouth dripping venom.

name: earth hound
description: A beautiful crystalline shape does not disguise the danger this hound clearly presents. Your flesh tingles as it approaches.

name: air hound
description: Swirling vapours surround this beast as it floats towards you, seemingly walking on air. Noxious gases sting your throat.

name: sabre-tooth tiger
description: A fierce and dangerous cat, its huge tusks and sharp claws would lacerate even the strongest armour.

name: water hound
description: Liquid footprints follow this hound as it pads around the dungeon. An acrid smell of acid rises from the dog's pelt.

name: chimaera
description: It is a strange concoction of goat, lion and dragon, with the heads of all three beasts.

name: quylthulg
description: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.

name: sasquatch
description: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.

name: werewolf
description: It is a huge wolf with eyes that glow with manly intelligence.

name: dark dwarven lord
description: A leader of Morgoth's eastern dwarf recruits, dressed in black chainmail and radiating evil power.

name: ranger
description: A warrior who is at one with nature. A master of both bow and sword, with minor spellcasting skills, and animals come to do his bidding.

name: paladin
description: A warrior for a holy cause. Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.

name: Lugdush, the Uruk
description: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.

name: blue dragon bat
description: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.

name: scroll mimic
description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded scroll to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

name: fire vortex
description: A whirling maelstrom of fire.

name: water vortex
description: A caustic spinning whirlpool of water.

name: cold vortex
description: A twisting whirlpool of frost.

name: mummified orc
description: It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.

name: neekerbreeker
description: Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek, neek-breek". The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.

name: Uglúk, the Uruk
description: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.

name: killer stag beetle
description: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.

name: iron golem
description: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.

name: giant yellow scorpion
description: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.

name: wyvern
description: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal. Beware its poisonous sting!

name: phase spider
description: A spider that never seems quite there. Everywhere you look it is just half-seen in the corner of one eye.

name: black ooze
description: It is a strangely moving puddle.

name: Easterling champion
description: A scarred warrior who wields an axe and moves with confidence.

name: Azog, Enemy of the Dwarves
description: A great orc with a huge iron-clad head, agile and strong. He is notorious for starting the War of the Dwarves and Orcs by killing Durin's heir, Thrór.

name: brigand
description: A thief of great power and shifty speed.

name: red dragon bat
description: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.

name: giant silver ant
description: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite and hard scales.

name: forest wight
description: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.

name: Ibun, Son of Mîm
description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

name: Khîm, Son of Mîm
description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Khîm is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

name: 4-headed hydra
description: A 3-headed hydra with an extra, smouldering, head.

name: mummified human
description: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.

name: vampire bat
description: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.

name: Sangahyando of Umbar
description: A Black Númenórean with a blacker heart.

name: Angamaitë of Umbar
description: A Black Númenórean who hates the men of the west.

name: banshee
description: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.

name: werebear
description: In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence. And then its form begins to change... The combination of animal cunning, human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for a dangerous enemy.

name: nruling
description: Little sparks of flame that dance around you, lashing whips and cursing horribly.

name: necromancer
description: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.

name: hill giant
description: A ten foot tall humanoid with powerful muscles.

name: pukelman
description: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes, this sentinel strides towards you with deadly intent.

name: stone troll
description: He is a large, lumpish troll with scabrous black skin.

name: carrion crawler
description: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.

name: killer red beetle
description: It is a giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.

name: abyss worm mass
description: A writhing wormlike shimmer of blackness, large as your arm. It squirms through air and walls with equal facility, leaving void in its wake.

name: giant firefly
description: Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can barely see through them.

name: giant grey ant
description: It is an ant encased in an impenetrable exoskeleton.

name: Ulwarth, Son of Ulfang
description: A short and swarthy Easterling.

name: displacer beast
description: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.

name: giant fire tick
description: It is smoking and burning with great heat.

name: cave ogre
description: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.

name: disenchanter bat
description: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.

name: wolf chieftain
description: A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord, and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.

name: Mîm, Betrayer of Turin
description: The last of his race, Mîm is a Petty-Dwarf. Petty-Dwarves are strange creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East. They have been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.

name: killer fire beetle
description: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.

name: creeping adamantite coins
description: It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward you on lots of tiny legs.

name: troll scavenger
description: A powerful, man-eating troll, its claws foul with the traces of its last kill.

name: vibration hound
description: A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can follow. You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.

name: nexus hound
description: A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge hound. Or is it just your imagination?

name: vampire
description: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.

name: gorgimaera
description: The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be alive. It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a lion's body.

name: ogre shaman
description: It is an ogre wrapped in furs and covered in grotesque body paints.

name: shimmering mold
description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.

name: frost giant
description: A twelve foot tall giant covered in furs.

name: spirit naga
description: A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman.

name: 5-headed hydra
description: A 4-headed hydra with an extra head, steaming with acidic vapor.

name: black knight
description: A hulking figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you menacingly.

name: Uldor the Accursed
description: An evil and cunning man from the East. Having once sworn allegiance to the sons of Fëanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.

name: mage
description: A mage of some power - you can tell by the size of his hat.

name: mind flayer
description: A humanoid form with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing eyes. Claws reach out for you and you feel a presence invade your mind.

name: Draebor, the Imp
description: An intensely irritating git of a monster.

name: basilisk
description: A vile reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers. Its eyes stare deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!

name: snow troll
description: He is a white troll with shaggy fur and powerfully clawed hands.

name: bat of Gorgoroth
description: Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature seeks livelier prey.

name: spectator
description: A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth, a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top of its body.

name: Beorn, the Shape-Changer
description: Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to appear in the shape of a giant black bear: he also prefers the company of beasts to that of humans. He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in human form.

name: Beorn, the Mountain Bear
description: Beorn in his form as a great black bear of the mountains, grown to giant-size in wrath. The roar of his voice is like drums, and no weapon seems to bite upon him.

name: green elf archer
description: An elf of the Land of the Seven Rivers, whose woodcraft was such that a stranger might pass through their land from end to end and see none of them.

name: giant black scorpion
description: A gleaming black scorpion as large as a lion, with a pulsating stinger and two great deadly claws.

name: purple worm
description: It is a massive worm form, many feet in length. Its vast maw drips acid and poison.

name: catoblepas
description: A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks like the creation of some deranged alchemist.

name: ring mimic
description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a discarded ring to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

name: young blue dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a deep blue in hue. Sparks crackle along its length.

name: young white dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a frosty white in hue. Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.

name: young green dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a deep green in hue. Foul gas seeps through its scales.

name: energy vortex
description: A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.

name: mithril golem
description: It is a massive statue of purest mithril. It looks expensive!

name: skeleton troll
description: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.

name: manticore
description: It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in vicious spikes.

name: giant blue ant
description: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.

name: giant army ant
description: An armoured form moving with purpose. Powerful on its own, flee when hordes of them march.

name: grave wight
description: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.

name: killer slicer beetle
description: It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard carapace.

name: ogre chieftain
description: This ogre is leader of his tribe. He sneers at you as he advances towards you, wielding a huge club and pushing his own followers rudely aside.

name: ghast
description: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.

name: Bert the Stone Troll
description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bill and Tom.

name: Bill the Stone Troll
description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Tom.

name: Tom the Stone Troll
description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Bill.

name: ghost
description: You don't believe in it. But it believes in you...

name: death watch beetle
description: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.

name: young black dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a darkest black hue. Acid drips from its body.

name: young gold dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.

name: young red dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Its still-tender scales are a deepest red hue. Heat radiates from its form.

name: huorn
description: A tree which has become entish, or maybe an ent which has become tree-ish.

name: serpent of the brownlands
description: A great serpent, with coils of steel, a lunge faster than the eye can see, and fangs that drip with acidic poison. Its eyes are mesmerizing.

name: ogre mage
description: A hideous ogre wrapped in black sorcerous robes.

name: nexus quylthulg
description: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.

name: southron assassin
description: A man of Harad clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.

name: memory moss
description: A mass of green vegetation. You don't remember seeing anything like it before.

name: young multi-hued dragon
description: It has a form that legends are made of. Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.

name: doombat
description: It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat surrounded by flickering bright red flames.

name: drúadan druid
description: A short, stocky man with an uncanny connection with nature.

name: stone giant
description: It is eighteen feet tall and looking at you.

name: shadow drake
description: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in shadow. Glowing red eyes shine out in the dark, and it is surrounded by an aura of unearthly cold that chills the soul rather than the body.

name: cave troll
description: He is a vicious monster, feared for his ferocity.

name: mystic
description: An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power. He can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any pain.

name: barrow wight
description: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.

name: skeleton etten
description: It is the animated form of a massive two-headed troll.

name: chaos drake
description: A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos. It seems first ugly, then fair, as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.

name: law drake
description: This dragon is clever and cunning. It laughs at your puny efforts to disturb it.

name: balance drake
description: A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance, and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.

name: ethereal drake
description: A dragon of great power, with control over light and dark, the ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.

name: fire elemental
description: It is a towering inferno of flames.

name: water elemental
description: It is a towering tempest of water.

name: crystal drake
description: A dragon of strange crystalline form. Light shines through it, dazzling your eyes with spectra of colour.

name: troll priest
description: A troll who is so bright he knows how to read.

name: Maia
description: One of the first children of Eru, currently human-like in form, its body shining with glorious light. Whether this being has taken allegiance to Morgoth or faces you in combat for some other reason is not clear; all you know is that it stands before you, its eyes ablaze as it prepares its next volley of spells.

name: troll blackguard
description: A half-smart, vicious troll with some rudimentary magic and a love of violence.

name: shade
description: A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness. A powerful undead creature with a deadly touch.

name: master thief
description: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!

name: Ulfang the Black
description: A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black. He and his three sons once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the pay of Morgoth.

name: lich
description: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It radiates vastly evil power.

name: earth elemental
description: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.

name: air elemental
description: It is a towering tornado of winds.

name: Eog golem
description: It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an all-too-familiar purpose. Your magic surprisingly feels much less powerful now.

name: wereworm
description: A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul monster that breeds on death.

name: Lokkak, the Ogre Chieftain
description: An ogre renowned for acts of surpassing cruelty, Lokkak quickly became the leader of a large band of violent ogres.

name: hill troll
description: Clad only in close-fitting mesh of horny scales (unless that is his skin) this troll strides toward you roaring like a beast, wielding a heavy hammer in his knotted hand.

name: invisible stalker
description: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.

name: gravity hound
description: Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures are walking on the walls and even the ceiling! The earth suddenly feels rather less solid as you see gravity warp all round the monsters.

name: inertia hound
description: Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches you with deadly menace. It makes you tired just to look at it.

name: impact hound
description: A deep brown shape is visible before you, its canine form strikes you with an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a powerful blow as it stalks towards you.

name: mûmak
description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

name: giant fire ant
description: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its powerful jaws glow with heat.

name: chest mimic
description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a chest to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws. The first that most adventurers realise of the deception is when the seemingly invitingly open lid of the chest suddenly grows teeth and then slams shut on the adventurer's hand...

name: silent watcher
description: A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow with a malevolent light.

name: olog
description: It is a massive intelligent troll with needle-sharp fangs.

name: colbran
description: A man-shaped form of living lightning. Sparks and shocks crackle all over this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.

name: cloud giant
description: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.

name: master vampire
description: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.

name: ooze elemental
description: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.

name: smoke elemental
description: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.

name: xorn
description: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.

name: colossus
description: An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone. It strides purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering power.

name: trapper
description: A larger cousin of the lurker, this creature traps unsuspecting victims and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.

name: bodak
description: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.

name: dúnadan of Angmar
description: A necromancer recruited to the evil realm of Angmar during the decline of the North Kingdom.

name: Lorgan, Chief of the Easterlings
description: A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot control.

name: demonologist
description: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.

name: gauth
description: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.

name: ice elemental
description: It is a towering glacier of ice.

name: mummified troll
description: It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings. You are wary of its massive fists.

name: spectre
description: A phantasmal shrieking spirit. Its wail drives the intense cold of pure evil deep within your body.

name: magma elemental
description: It is a towering glowing form of molten hate.

name: killer iridescent beetle
description: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.

name: nexus vortex
description: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.

name: plasma vortex
description: A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.

name: mountain troll
description: A massive troll, larger and stronger than many men together. It needs no weapons aside from its massive hands and feet.

name: shardstorm
description: A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous magics.

name: emperor wight
description: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.

name: mummified chieftain
description: A powerful ruler who refused the summons of Mandos on death, preferring to re-occupy his now embalmed body. He commands a legion of his former subjects with unearthly shrieks.

name: will o' the wisp
description: A strange ball of glowing light. It disappears and reappears and seems to draw you to it. You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its strange dancing motion.

name: death knight
description: It is a humanoid figure dressed in armour of an ancient form. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red and seem to pierce you like lances of fire.

name: Castamir the Usurper
description: A Black Númenórean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and evil.

name: time vortex
description: You haven't seen it yet.

name: shimmering vortex
description: A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes. Its shape changes constantly as it cuts through the air towards you. It is like a beacon, waking monsters from their slumber.

name: white wraith
description: It is a tangible but ghostly form made of white fog.

name: etten
description: A massive two-headed troll of huge strength, ettens are stupid but violent. They are also living proof that two heads are not more intelligent than one...

name: abyss spider
description: A massive spider, heaving the bloated bag of its body between great spined legs.

name: southron archer
description: A man of Harad clad in black and red and carrying a longbow. His quiver is full of red feathered arrows, and carries an insignia of a black serpent.

name: mature white dragon
description: A large dragon, scales gleaming bright white.

name: mature blue dragon
description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep blue.

name: mature green dragon
description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep green.

name: 6-headed hydra
description: A 5-headed hydra which seems to have an extra head, if you could just see it properly.

name: night mare
description: A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes, that watch you with little more than a hatred of all that lives.

name: beholder
description: A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.

name: disenchanter worm mass
description: It is a strange mass of squirming worms. Magical energy crackles around its disgusting form.

name: spirit troll
description: A weird ghostly troll-like being.

name: phantom
description: An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being saps your very soul.

name: 7-headed hydra
description: A 6-headed hydra with an extra head that waves mesmerisingly at you.

name: enchantress
description: This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, whom she rarely fights without.

name: sorcerer
description: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting.

name: xaren
description: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.

name: giant roc
description: A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.

name: minotaur
description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

name: vrock
description: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.

name: death quasit
description: It is a demon of small stature, but its armoured frame moves with lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.

name: patriarch
description: A priest of great power, he is convinced of the righteousness of his beliefs. Stand in his way at your peril.

name: troll chieftain
description: This troll's great strength and size have won it the place of chieftain of its tribe. It fears nothing.

name: mature red dragon
description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep red.

name: mature gold dragon
description: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.

name: mature black dragon
description: A large dragon, with scales of deepest black.

name: stiffbeard sorcerer
description: A dwarf with plaited beard and painted face, dressed in deepest black. Power seems to crackle from his stocky frame.

name: master lich
description: A skeletal form wrapped in robes. Powerful magic crackles along its bony fingers.

name: Gorlim, Betrayer of Barahir
description: This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife. And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.

name: ranger chieftain
description: A chieftain among the Rangers. His understanding of nature gives him powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills as an archer and a warrior. Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.

name: Kavlax the Many-Headed
description: A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.

name: hellhound
description: It is a giant wolf that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.

name: black-hearted huorn
description: A huorn with a bad heart.

name: The Queen Ant
description: She's upset because you hurt her children.

name: Rogrog the Black Troll
description: A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down his muscular frame. Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.

name: Maia of Nienna
description: A servant of Nienna, who grieves for the hurts to the world caused by Morgoth.

name: Maia of Mandos
description: A servant of Mandos, the summoner of the spirits of the slain.

name: mature multi-hued dragon
description: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.

name: Vargo, Tyrant of Fire
description: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.

name: Waldern, King of Water
description: A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid. Wave after wave drowns your frail body.

name: glabrezu
description: It is demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.

name: Quaker, Master of Earth
description: A towering stone elemental stands before you. The walls and ceiling are reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.

name: Ariel, Queen of Air
description: A towering air elemental, Ariel, the sorceress, avoids your blows with her extreme speed.

name: multi-hued hound
description: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.

name: 8-headed hydra
description: A 7-headed hydra with an extra head which reeks of death.

name: dread
description: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.

name: killer white beetle
description: A giant beetle with a gleaming white carapace. The air condenses around its mandibles as it scuttles toward you.

name: rotting quylthulg
description: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.

name: nalfeshnee
description: It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar. Flames run up and down its length.

name: undead beholder
description: A beholder which has cheated death. Black nether storms rage around the bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it sucks its power from the very air around it. Your soul chills as it drains your vitality for its evil enchantments.

name: demonic quylthulg
description: A pile of pulsing flesh that reeks of sulfur. The world itself seems to cry out against it.

name: draconic quylthulg
description: It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.

name: greater basilisk
description: A large basilisk, whose shape resembles that of a great wyrm.

name: berserker
description: Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain. He tramples weaker creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.

name: cyclops
description: A gigantic ugly humanoid with but one eye and very thick skin.

name: grey wraith
description: A tangible but ghostly form, made of grey fog. The air around it feels deathly cold.

name: lord of Carn Dûm
description: An evil priest, dressed all in black. Deadly spells hit you at an alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your pitiful frame.

name: vampire lord
description: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.

name: marilith
description: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.

name: death mold
description: It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold. Its lifeless form draws power from sucking the souls of those that approach it, a nimbus of pure evil surrounds it. Luckily for you, it can't move.

name: ancient spider
description: A foul creature of spider form, older even than the pits of Angband.

name: winged horror
description: A terrifying sight: a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings. Descended from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged steed for his Ringwraiths.

name: gorgon
description: This creature of legend has not just a serpent's body, but snakes for hair. Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, eyes blazing, venom dripping from her ghastly mouth.

name: storm giant
description: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.

name: lesser Balrog
description: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.

name: black wraith
description: A figure that seems made of void, its strangely human shape is cloaked in shadow. It reaches out at you.

name: Eöl, the Dark Elf
description: A lord of the Teleri, Eöl is a mighty metalsmith, the only one to ever forge weapons of meteorite iron. The mortal enemy of the Eldar, he is currently fleeing their wrath, following the murder of Princess Aredhel of Gondolin.

name: ancient blue dragon
description: A huge draconic form. Lightning crackles along its length.

name: ancient white dragon
description: A huge draconic form. Frost covers it from head to tail.

name: ancient green dragon
description: A huge draconic form enveloped in clouds of poisonous vapour.

name: death drake
description: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness. You cannot make out its true form but you sense its evil.

name: great crystal drake
description: A huge crystalline dragon. Its claws could cut you to shreds and its teeth are razor sharp. Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in the light.

name: ethereal dragon
description: This terrible dragon is a master of light and dark. Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks itself in unearthly shadows.

name: master mystic
description: A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways. He is a master of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the wild if need be.

name: shadow
description: A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form. Razor-edged claws reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the energy from your soul to feed its power.

name: The Balrog of Moria
description: A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire, this is indeed a terrible opponent. Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword, his fury blisters your skin and melts your flesh!

name: ancient black dragon
description: A huge draconic form. Pools of acid melt the floor around it.

name: ancient red dragon
description: A huge draconic form. Wisps of smoke steam from its nostrils and the extreme heat surrounding it makes you gasp for breath.

name: ancient gold dragon
description: A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light. Its roar stuns and deafens you.

name: nether hound
description: You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of darkness in the shape of a large dog.

name: time hound
description: You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition? All at once you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog. Perhaps you should give up and go to bed.

name: plasma hound
description: The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the shape of a giant hound. Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as you sense trouble.

name: Harowen the Black Hand
description: He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and moves with blinding speed. Check your pockets!

name: Maia of Oromë
description: A servant of Oromë, hunter of monsters and fell beasts.

name: hasty ent
description: Ents are not altogether on anybody's side, because nobody is altogether on their side. This one seems quite roused, and does not seem to be on your side.

name: Itangast the Fire Drake
description: A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh. Wisps of smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.

name: hezrou
description: A sluggish demon of lizard form, firing powerful missiles. From the terribly oversized jaws to the stumpy lashing tail, pools of burning acid froth and sizzle.

name: ancient multi-hued dragon
description: A huge draconic form. Many colours ripple down its massive frame. Few live to see another.

name: chaos vortex
description: Void, nothingness, spinning destructively.

name: Scatha the Worm
description: An ancient and wise Dragon. Scatha has grown clever over the long years. His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice into the air.

name: The Phoenix
description: A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your skin and melts your armour.

name: drolem
description: A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength. Powerful spells weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary. Its eyes show little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.

name: demilich
description: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.

name: dreadmaster
description: It is an unlife of power almost unequaled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.

name: nether wraith
description: A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it. As it nears you, a coldness saps your soul.

name: Shelob, Spider of Darkness
description: Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the Unlight. Her poison is legendary, as is her ego. She normally guards the pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to feed her voracious appetite.

name: dracolich
description: The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most perilous. Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its prey to satisfy its hunger.

name: dracolisk
description: A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.

name: Ar-Pharazôn the Golden
description: Last and proudest king of ancient Númenor. Corrupted by power and avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the Valar themselves, and condemned Númenor to oblivion.

name: barbazu
description: A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet, and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard. They are the elite shock troops of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.

name: lesser titan
description: It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power and hate.

name: grand master mystic
description: He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures with disdainful ease.

name: hand druj
description: A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing fingers.

name: 9-headed hydra
description: A massive legendary hydra, like an 8-headed hydra, but with a massive extra head that opens its mighty jaws at you. Its many eyes stare at you as clouds of vapour rise from its seething form. And it grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.

name: Baphomet the Minotaur Lord
description: A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses all that defy him.

name: elder vampire
description: A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.

name: Fundin Bluecloak
description: He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth. Fundin has earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and spell only justify his position further. His combination of both dwarven strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.

name: Gilim, the Giant of Eruman
description: Known as the giant of winter and the northern reaches, he is tall even among giants, and his name is cursed in many lands.

name: Maia of Yavanna
description: A servant of Yavanna Kementári, Queen of the Earth, the Giver of Fruits and lover of all things that grow.

name: Maia of Aulë
description: A servant of Aulë the Smith, lord of all the substances of Arda and friend of the Noldor.

name: great earth elemental
description: Appearing as a giant of stone, this mighty elemental seems to draw its power from the very fabric of the dungeon.

name: aether vortex
description: An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.

name: Saruman of Many Colours
description: Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles. He seeks to emulate him and breeds orcs and trolls to fight for him. He searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the world.

name: nightwing
description: Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chillier. At the centre of the cold stands a mighty figure. Its wings envelop you in the chill of death as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion. Your muscles sag and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty being.

name: bile demon
description: It's big. It's fat. It's red. It's ugly. It's got a severe attack of highly poisonous flatulence. And its insides are corrosive. All of which go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have ever experienced.

name: dreadlord
description: It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black. It drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of its evil. It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and the stench of death. Flee its hunger!

name: Smaug the Golden
description: Smaug is one of the Urulóki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense cunning and intelligence. His speed through air is matched by few other dragons and his dragonfire is what legends are made of; he is believed to be the greatest dragon still surviving into the Third Age.

name: werewolf of Sauron
description: A massive wolf, appearing like a mighty shadow. Its glowing red eyes glare malevolently as it defends its evil master's fortress.

name: spider of Gorgoroth
description: One of the hideous brood of Ungoliant, spawned in the endless shadow of Nan Dungortheb beneath the mountains of Ered Gorgoroth.

name: chaos hound
description: A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if expecting mayhem and chaos ahead. It appears to have an almost kamikaze relish for combat. You suspect all may not be as it seems.

name: archlich
description: A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely immaterial state.

name: Maia of Ulmo
description: A servant of Ulmo, Lord of Waters, who speaks to those who dwell in Middle-earth with voices that are heard only as the music of water.

name: great water elemental
description: A mighty column of water, terrible as a mounting wave that strides to the land.

name: The Mouth of Sauron
description: The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster. So old that even he cannot remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable. He believes unshakably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome spells.

name: osyluth
description: It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones. It is humanoid, but with a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell of decay and rot. They are despised even in the hells.

name: Fëanorian raider
description: A veteran of the battles waged by Fëanor and his sons in pursuit of the Silmarils, he attacks you with agility, power and cruelty.

name: eye druj
description: A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it harmless.

name: greater titan
description: A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks. The power radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your defiance.

name: Tevildo, Prince of Cats
description: Master of all things feline, Tevildo serves his master Morgoth well. He delights in small torments and cunning stratagems, and laughs merrily as he bats you about.

name: Thuringwethil, the Vampire Messenger
description: Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is surely the most deadly of her vampire race. At first she is charming to meet, but her wings and eyes give away her true form.

name: beholder hive-mother
description: A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid whenever she wishes.

name: jabberwock
description: "Beware the Jabberwock, my son! The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!" Run and run quickly, for death incarnate chases behind you!

name: Tselakus, the Dreadlord
description: This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space. A master of mighty magic, Tselakus hungers for your tender flesh. Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail of death and destruction. Tselakus is a being of sneering contempt, laughing at your pitiful efforts to defy him. Mighty claws rend reality as he annihilates all in his path to your soul!

name: bone golem
description: A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its previous victims.

name: hound of Tindalos
description: Bodies of death, receptacles of all foulness, they emerge like smoke from the angles of time, ravenous and snarling and unsatisfied.

name: Nan, the Giant
description: Known as the giant of summer and the south, he towers above you like a great elm. In his right hand, he holds the longest sword you have ever beheld.

name: nightcrawler
description: This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm. Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, acid drips from its steely hide. It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs down your spine as you face it.

name: gelugon
description: This demon from the icy regions is a truly terrifying sight. It has an extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges with great multi-faceted eyes. Its tail is covered with razor-sharp spikes.

name: great storm wyrm
description: A vast dragon of power. Storms and lightning crash around its titanic form. Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's great muscles. It regards you with contempt.

name: great ice wyrm
description: An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction. You have never felt such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare. Begone quickly or feel its wrath!

name: great swamp wyrm
description: A truly enormous dragon with great powers. The foul gases issuing from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.

name: Maia of Manwë
description: A servant of Manwë Súlimo, the first of all Kings, lord of the realm of Arda and ruler of all that dwell therein.

name: Maia of Varda
description: A servant of Varda, Lady of the Stars, who the elves call Elbereth and love above all the Valar.

name: greater demonic quylthulg
description: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, strongly reeking of sulfur.

name: greater draconic quylthulg
description: A massive mound of multi-hued scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating.

name: greater rotting quylthulg
description: A massive pile of rotting flesh. A disgusting stench fills the air as it throbs and writhes.

name: horned reaper
description: A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe. Feared by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even the minions it has just summoned.

name: Ossë, Herald of Ulmo
description: Encrusted with barnacles, slimy and dripping, the Maia of the untamed sea has dragged himself down into Angband to send you to a watery grave. Ossë is the most powerful and heartless of Ulmo's servants and embodies the untamed power of the ocean. Terror grows in your heart with each squelching step of his approach.

name: great hell wyrm
description: A vast dragon of immense power. Fire leaps continuously from its huge form. The air around it scalds you. Its slightest glance burns you, and you truly realize how insignificant you are.

name: great bile wyrm
description: A huge and very powerful dragon. Great steaming pools of acid drip from its form onto the ground. You shudder when you see the acid eating away the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

name: great wyrm of thunder
description: A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match. The sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly enough to defend yourself adequately.

name: nightwalker
description: A huge giant garbed in black, it breaks your armour from your back, leaving you defenseless against its evil wrath. It can smell your fear, and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure strides towards you menacingly.

name: Omarax, the Eye Tyrant
description: A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air. His gaze seems to shred your soul and his spells crush your will. He is ancient, his history steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.

name: skull druj
description: A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power. It need not move, but merely blast you with mighty magic as it speaks the words of power.

name: black reaver
description: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.

name: aether hound
description: A shifting, swirling form. It seems to be all colours and sizes and shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog. You feel very uncertain all of a sudden.

name: great wyrm of chaos
description: A massive dragon of changing form. As you watch, it appears first fair and then foul. Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real. Its very existence distorts the universe around it.

name: great wyrm of law
description: A massive dragon of powerful intellect. It seeks to dominate the universe and despises all other life. It sees all who do not obey it as mere insects to be crushed underfoot.

name: Ungoliant, the Unlight
description: This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of immense proportions. She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of darkness. She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to avoid starvation.

name: bronze golem
description: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue of demonic shape, glowing with great heat.

name: Glaurung, Father of the Dragons
description: Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most powerful. Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes. He is the definition of dragonfire.

name: master quylthulg
description: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.

name: Makar, the Warrior
description: A battle-hungry spirit from amongst the Ainur, who built a grim hall in the early days of Arda to host endless battles. When not at home, he and his sister Meássë hunt and seek out the turmoils caused by Morgoth.

name: Feagwath, the Undead Sorcerer
description: A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.

name: pit fiend
description: Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the pit fiend is a dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells. They are often the commanders of vast demon armies.

name: Uvatha the Horseman
description: A tall black cloaked Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship. He longs to taste your blood.

name: serpent of chaos
description: Writhing coil upon coil, this mighty spawn of chaos constantly disintegrates and reforms before your dazzled eyes. It seeks to obliterate you utterly; beware!

name: Adunaphel the Quiet
description: A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the power of the rings.

name: Qlzqqlzuup, the Emperor Quylthulg
description: A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front of your eyes. Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it must bring help to protect itself.

name: Akhorahil the Blind
description: A mighty sorcerer King, Akhorahil was blind in life. With powerful enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than any ordinary man ever could.

name: fury
description: A female embodiment of rage, intent on tearing your mind and body apart.

name: great wyrm of annihilation
description: A massive dragon of hideous form. From its shadowy aura comes the stench of the underworld. Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real. Its very existence distorts the universe around it.

name: sky dragon
description: A wrathful dragon, of a breed that even legends do not mention, rushing towards you like a thunderbolt. Few ever face the wyrms of the exotic airs; fewer live to tell the tale.

name: Wiruin, the Maelstrom
description: A violent icy whirlpool, brought from the frozen wastes of the Helcaraxë by Morgoth as guard and entertainment. Smaller vortices arise on its edges, and you feel as if you will never be free of its deafening roar.

name: Ren the Unclean
description: Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a volcano god. At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that wiped out his family, and he never recovered.

name: Maeglin, the Traitor of Gondolin
description: The son of Eöl the Dark Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father and more. His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of Gondolin to Morgoth's forces. He is a mighty warrior himself, and some of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.

name: Ji Indur Dawndeath
description: This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under Sauron's power.

name: great wyrm of balance
description: A massive dragon, one of the mightiest of dragonkind. It is thousands of years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance. It sees you as an upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions. It will destroy you.

name: great wyrm of many colours
description: A gigantic dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.

name: Pazuzu, Lord of Air
description: A winged humanoid demon, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at you as he decides your fate.

name: Dwar, Dog Lord of Waw
description: Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them at will. He howls maniacally as he reaches out to destroy you.

name: Hoarmurath of Dir
description: A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has lost for an unlife of everlasting torment.

name: Draugluin, Sire of All Werewolves
description: Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard. He is an enormous wolf inhabited with a human spirit. He is chief of all his kind.

name: Khamûl, the Black Easterling
description: A warrior-king of the East. Khamûl is a powerful opponent, his skill in combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.

name: Cantoras, the Skeletal Lord
description: A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty sorcerer. His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the underworld. Flee his wrath!

name: greater Balrog
description: Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible demonic servants. With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.

name: The Witch-King of Angmar
description: The most fell of all Sauron's captains: King of Angmar, Sorcerer, Ringwraith, Lord of the Nazgûl, a spear of terror in the hand of Sauron, shadow of despair. His spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard. He moves at speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding. It is said that he is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.

name: Ancalagon the Black
description: "Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.

name: The Tarrasque
description: The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable and immune to magic. Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!

name: Meássë, the Bloody
description: Sister of Makar the Warrior, she would shout encouragement to the warriors of their hall and heal their wounds so they could battle on, until her arms were reddened to the elbow. Meássë is delighted by all violence, and recruits any beings of like abilities to her service.

name: Lungorthin, the Balrog of White Fire
description: A massive form cloaked in flame. Lungorthin stares balefully at you with eyes that smoulder red. The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by the heat of his body.

name: Huan, Wolfhound of the Valar
description: The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from Celegorm son of Fëanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis - Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of Angband.

name: Carcharoth, the Jaws of Thirst
description: The first guard of Angband, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is the greatest wolf to ever walk the earth. He is highly intelligent and a deadly opponent in combat.

name: Vecna, the Emperor Lich
description: The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him. This ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.

name: storm of Unmagic
description: Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this whirlpool of Unmagic rips the enchantments from everything it touches.

name: Gothmog, the High Captain of Balrogs
description: Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard. He is renowned for slaying Fëanor and Fingon, two of the High Kings of the Noldor, and has never been defeated in combat. With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.

name: Sauron, the Sorcerer
description: Greatest and most terrible of the servants of Morgoth, creator of the One Ring. A sorcerer of dreadful powers, master of shadows and of phantoms, foul in wisdom, cruel in strength, misshaping what he rules, lord of werewolves; his dominion is torment. He has many servants, and rarely fights without them.

name: Wolf-Sauron
description: Sauron's form as the mightiest wolf to walk the world.

name: Serpent-Sauron
description: Sauron's form as a serpent: poisonous, biting, spitting, and threatening to crush you in its mighty coils.

name: Vampire-Sauron
description: Sauron's form as a vampire, great as a dark cloud across the moon.

name: Morgoth, Lord of Darkness
description: He is the Master of the Pits of Angband. His figure is like a black mountain crowned with lightning. He rages with everlasting anger, his body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds. He can never rest from his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the world. He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul creatures with his evil powers. Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please him. His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the two remaining Silmarils forever burning him. Grond, the mighty Hammer of the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a pulp!
